articles.title: Chinese exile once linked to Trump strategist gets 30-year sentence in $1 billion fraud
articles.snippet: The businessman known as Miles Guo, who pushed the fraudulent H-Coin project and had close ties to Steve Bannon, was finally sentenced after his 2024 conviction.

articles.title: Donald Trump has 10 days to decide on housing bill with CBDC ban
articles.snippet: House Speaker Mike Johnson transmitted a housing bill with a provision barring the US Federal Reserve issuing or creating a CBDC until 2030 to Donald Trump on Monday.

articles.title: Supreme Court Says Trump Can Fire SEC, CFTC Commissioners at Will—At a Crucial Moment for Crypto
articles.snippet: The court overturned a 91-year precedent, allowing President Trump to fire key federal regulators whenever he wishes for almost any reason.

articles.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-5.6—But Only for Some Users Due to Trump Admin
articles.snippet: OpenAI introduced the GPT-5.6 family of AI models on Friday, but only limited users can access them for now thanks to the U.S. government.

articles.title: Trump Administration Asks OpenAI to Limit GPT-5.6 Rollout: Reports
articles.snippet: The reported request to OpenAI follows the Trump administration's move to limit access to Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models.
